title: BadScientist: Can a Research Agent Write Convincing but Unsound Papers that Fool LLM Reviewers?

contributions.purpose: 检验 AI 造假论文能否骗过 AI 审稿
contributions.mechanism: BadScientist 框架:造假生成器(5 种呈现操纵策略,不做真实验)对多模型 LLM 审稿团,审稿阈值用 ICLR 2025 数据校准(N=200,τrate=7@接受率31.73%)
contributions.domain: AI 科研代理 / LLM 同行评审安全
contributions.source_quote: we introduce BadScientist, an experimental framework that pits a fabrication-oriented paper generation agent against a multi-model LLM review agent.

contributions.purpose: 揭示造假论文高接受率
contributions.mechanism: 按 5 种单策略与组合(All)统计接受率
contributions.evaluation: TooGoodGains 接受 67.0%/82.0%(两阈值),组合 All 52.0%/69.0%
contributions.source_quote: fabricated papers achieve high acceptance rates across strategies, with TooGoodGains reaching 67.0%/82.0% acceptance... and combined strategies achieving 52.0%/69.0%.

contributions.mechanism: 同时统计诚信关切率(ICR)与接受率
contributions.evaluation: All 设置 ICR@M 51.7% 却仍接受 52.0%,即审稿标记诚信问题仍给接受级分数
contributions.source_quote: Even when LLM reviewers flag integrity concerns, they frequently assign acceptance-level scores—a phenomenon we term concern-acceptance conflict.

contributions.purpose: 评估缓解手段有效性(负结果)
contributions.evaluation: 提升有限,不足以修复漏洞
contributions.source_quote: Our mitigation strategies, Review-with-Detection (ReD) and Detection-Only (DetOnly), show limited improvements, highlighting the inadequacy of current methods.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our agent framework is adapted from AI-Scientist [19], but we have fundamentally redesigned its entire pipeline. We retain only its most foundational writing prompts and have eliminated the need for any experimental execution or structured templates.

notes: 元研究/攻击面论文:核心是关于 LLM 审稿的负结果(造假论文高接受、concern-acceptance conflict、缓解无效)。生成器"freely generate any necessary experimental results and plotting code"是刻意造假(研究设计的一部分),不属于对本文作者的数据造假红旗。checklist 对实验统计/合规均答 Yes。accept。
